# Yadkin Fire & Safety

> North Carolina fire safety equipment provider offering fire extinguishers, suppression systems, emergency lighting, and OSHA/NFPA compliance services across multiple counties.

Yadkin Fire & Safety (YFS Fire Safety Products) serves commercial and residential customers throughout North Carolina with fire protection equipment from brands like Ansul, Pyro-Chem, Buckeye, and FireTech. They provide inspection, maintenance, installation, and 24-hour emergency services for fire extinguishers, suppression systems, emergency lighting, and safety equipment.

## Key Topics

- Fire extinguisher services
- OSHA compliance
- NFPA standards
- Commercial fire protection
- Fire suppression systems
- Emergency lighting
- Ansul systems
- Pyro-Chem products
- Fire safety inspection
- Kitchen fire suppression
- Emergency eyewash stations
- Fire alarm batteries
- Fire extinguisher signage
- North Carolina service areas
- 24-hour emergency service
